articles.title: PhRMA Allocates Millions in Search Advertising to Criticize PBMs
articles.summary: Pharmaceutical industry lobbying group PhRMA directed nearly half of its $58.8 million search ad budget toward criticizing pharmacy benefit managers. This high-stakes public relations battle highlights the escalating tensions and scrutiny surrounding PBM business practices and drug pricing transparency. Self-funded employers and PBM executives must navigate this intensifying public and legislative pressure as scrutiny on drug supply chain margins grows.
articles.source_line: Source: Medical Daily; Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:26:18 GMT

articles.title: The State of Employer Pharmacy Benefits in 2026: Plan Savings and Patient Costs
articles.summary: This article examines the ongoing trend in employer-sponsored health plans where overall plan savings are increasingly achieved by shifting costs onto patients. For self-funded employers and PBMs, this dynamic highlights the challenge of balancing total cost management with employee affordability and benefit design.
articles.source_line: Source: Drug Channels; Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:00:00 GMT

articles.title: Employer PBM Satisfaction Declines Amid Rising Benefit Pressures
articles.summary: A recent industry report shows that while employer satisfaction with pharmacy benefit managers has declined, it still outperforms satisfaction with traditional health insurers. This trend highlights growing employer scrutiny over drug costs and plan performance, reinforcing the demand for transparent, high-value PBM alternatives.

articles.title: Eli Lilly and Hims & Hers Partner for Direct GLP-1 Telehealth Access
articles.summary: Eli Lilly has partnered with telehealth platform Hims & Hers to provide direct-to-consumer access to its GLP-1 medications, bypassing traditional pharmacy benefit channels. This trend threatens employer-sponsored plan management by encouraging out-of-pocket spending and employees bypassing traditional utilization management and prior authorization controls. PBMs and self-funded employers must monitor how direct-to-consumer channels impact plan utilization, total cost of care, and employee benefit engagement.

articles.title: CVS Health Announces Plan to Split Pharmacy and Health Care Businesses by 2028
articles.summary: CVS Health has announced plans to structurally separate its pharmacy and healthcare services divisions by 2028. This major corporate restructuring could significantly alter the competitive landscape for pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) and health plan integration, directly impacting self-funded employers evaluating vendor partnerships.

articles.title: BeneCard PBF Partners with Scripta to Enhance Prescription Navigation
articles.summary: BeneCard PBF is integrating Scripta Insights' pharmacy navigation platform into its offerings to improve transparency and help self-funded employers manage drug costs. This partnership highlights the growing market demand for advanced navigation and cost-containment tools in transparent PBM models.
articles.source_line: Source: PR Newswire; Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:00:00 GMT

articles.title: CVS Caremark Expands Biosimilar Access and Affordability Strategies
articles.summary: CVS Caremark has announced initiatives to expand access and affordability for biosimilar drugs within its formulary strategies. This move directly impacts self-funded employers by aiming to lower specialty drug spend through increased biosimilar adoption. Plan sponsors should evaluate how these formulary changes affect their overall specialty pharmacy cost management.
articles.source_line: Source: ACCESS Newswire; Tue, 10 Nov 2026 13:45:00 GMT

articles.title: CVS Caremark Expands Biosimilar Access and Affordability Strategies
articles.summary: CVS Caremark is expanding its formulary adoption and access strategies for biosimilars to drive down specialty drug costs. This shift impacts self-funded employers by potentially lowering net spend on high-cost biologics through increased market competition and substitution. Plan sponsors should evaluate how their PBM implements biosimilar placements to maximize cost savings.
articles.source_line: Source: Yahoo Finance; Tue, 10 Nov 2026 13:45:00 GMT

articles.title: BeneCard PBF Integrates Scripta’s Prescription Navigation for Clients
articles.summary: PBM BeneCard PBF has partnered with Scripta Insights to add prescription drug navigation tools to its client offerings. This integration aims to help self-funded employers guide members to lower-cost drug alternatives and manage escalating pharmacy benefit costs. The move highlights the growing demand for third-party navigation and transparency solutions within employer-sponsored health plans.
articles.source_line: Source: Chain Drug Review; Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:31:39 GMT
